prompt: AUTHORITY-CHECK returned a nonzero sy-subrc for changing company 1000. What must happen next?

options.explanation: The application must enforce the failed result before protected work.

options.text: Read another table, then check sy-subrc.
options.explanation: The read may overwrite sy-subrc and hide the authorization result.

options.text: Continue because the user could open the page.
options.explanation: Authentication and UI access do not grant this business permission.

options.text: Treat only sy-subrc 12 as a denial.
options.explanation: Other nonzero results also fail the check. Fail closed instead of granting access for an unhandled result.

prompt: A page ended at (09:00, 7). Another visible row is (09:00, 9). What must the next-page condition allow?

options.text: The same timestamp with an ID greater than 7.
options.explanation: The tie-breaker keeps row 9 while continuing after row 7.
That loses visible row 9, which shares the checkpoint timestamp.

options.text: Every row from 09:00 without a tie-breaker or page limit.
options.explanation: This neither identifies a stable continuation point nor bounds the page.

options.text: Use only the last ID and ignore the timestamp order.
options.explanation: The checkpoint must match the complete ordering; IDs alone need not increase with changed_at.

prompt: One test clears its input table. What keeps another test independent of that mutation?

options.text: Recreate the required input in setup before each test.
options.explanation: Each test receives the same known starting state, regardless of order.

options.text: Run the clearing test last by convention.
options.explanation: Test order is not a sound fixture contract.

options.text: Mark the class RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.
options.explanation: The risk label does not restore changed data or isolate dependencies.

options.text: Initialize mutable input only once in class_setup.
options.explanation: A shared mutable fixture still needs per-test reset; once-per-class initialization alone does not prevent interference.
